title: Rescan this unit
summary: Re-indexes the active project and re-lints the current unit on demand, so the Diagnostics panel drops findings already fixed
intro: Use it when the Diagnostics panel still shows a finding you have already fixed. Rules such as unused-unit-in-uses read the project index, and a save is not an edit, so this reindexes the project incrementally and re-lints the unit when that lands. Runs in the background; the status strip shows it.

surfaces.caption: Rescan this unit
steps: Open the Structure form (drag-lint > Show Structure)
Right-click in the Structure form and choose Rescan this unit
It reindexes the project in the background and re-lints the unit; the status strip shows progress

questions.ask: The Diagnostics panel still shows a finding I already fixed; how do I refresh it?
